en.title: Account Types & Roles
en.excerpt: A comprehensive guide explaining user roles on Archeris digital archery scoring system, featuring real-time target scoring, live leaderboards, and integrated tournament management from registration to final reports.

toc.text: 1. Tournament Organizer: Scoring Setup & Event Control
3. Field Scorekeeper: Fast Mobile Scoring at Target Line

en.content:
Archeris is a cloud-based digital archery scoring system built to digitize arrow-by-arrow scoring in real time directly on the shooting line. Along with core digital scoring capabilities (qualification rounds, elimination set systems, and live leaderboards), Archeris also provides complete tournament management tools—from online registration and payment processing to target butt allocation, official e-certificates, and championship reports.

To ensure smooth coordination across the scoring workflow and event operations, Archeris connects three primary user roles:

  • Tournament Organizers: Clubs, committees, and federations that configure scoring rules, manage registrations, and oversee the entire tournament.
  • Archers (Athletes): Competitors who sign up, complete payments, compete, monitor live arrow scores, and download official certificates.
  • Field Scorekeepers: Line officials and volunteers who input arrow values end by end on the shooting line.

1. Tournament Organizer: Scoring Setup & Event Control

An Organizer Account is tailored for archery clubs, regional committees, and event promoters. It provides all administrative tools required to manage scoring setups and tournament operations from preparation to final reporting:

  • Scoring Rules & Category Setup: Configure bow divisions (Recurve, Compound, Barebow, Traditional), age groups (U-12, U-15, Senior, Master), target distances, qualification rounds, and registration fees.
  • Online Registration & Payment Processing: Receive entries online with automated payment processing (QRIS, Virtual Accounts, and verified bank transfers) with real-time payment reconciliation.
  • Club Delegation & Roster Management: Review participant entries, approve pending rosters, and export official athlete line-ups in one click.
  • Target Butt Allocation (Target Line Management): Automatically or manually allocate archers to target butts (Target 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B, etc.) and generate printable target sheets.
  • Live Scoring Dashboard: Monitor qualification ends in real time as scorekeepers input arrows on the field.
  • Automated Elimination Brackets: When qualification concludes, the system instantly seeds archers into elimination match trees based on cumulative score rankings.
  • Official Reports & E-Certificates: Generate post-tournament PDF scorebooks, issue signed e-certificates with verification badges, and track tournament revenue summaries.

2. Archer (Athlete): Profile, Registration & Live Scores

An Archer Account is your personal archery passport. It is designed for individual competitors and parents managing youth athletes:

  • Saved Athlete Profile: Keep full name, date of birth, gender, and bow division stored securely for future events.
  • 1-Click Tournament Registration: Register for open tournaments in seconds. Saved profiles automatically fill in all registration forms without repetitive typing.
  • Seamless Checkout & Invoices: Pay tournament entry fees securely via QRIS, Virtual Account, or bank transfer and receive instant registration confirmation invoices.
  • Live Schedule & Target Info: Check assigned target butts, qualification schedules, and elimination bracket match-ups directly from your phone.
  • Live Scorecard Tracking: Follow arrow scores per end, total X's and 10's, and live qualification standings in real time.
  • Official E-Certificates: Download verified tournament participation and winner certificates whenever needed.

3. Field Scorekeeper: Fast Mobile Scoring at Target Line

A Scorekeeper is a field official or volunteer stationed at the target butts. Archeris makes target-line scoring effortless and distraction-free:

  • No Account Required: Volunteers do not need to register with an email or create passwords.
  • 5-Character Target Code: Enter a simple 5-character access code provided by the organizer (e.g. SK101) directly into any smartphone browser.
  • Touch-Optimized Arrow Input: Tap large buttons (X, 10, 9, 8, ... M/Miss) for each arrow shot during qualification or match play.
  • Instant Leaderboard Updates: Arrow values are immediately saved, calculating running scores and updating public display screens without delay.

4. Scoring Features & Role Comparison

The three roles on Archeris collaborate across every phase of the competition. Organizers handle setup, payments, and bracket seeding, Scorekeepers ensure reliable arrow inputs during active ends, and Archers experience a streamlined registration, live scoring, and certificate download flow.

Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the digital scoring and tournament management features available to each role:

Scoring Feature & Tournament Stage Organizer Archer Scorekeeper
Create tournament page, divisions & quotas Yes - -
Online registration & payment processing Yes (manage & receive) Yes (register & pay) -
Target line allocation (butt assignment) Yes Yes (view schedule) -
Mobile digital scoring at target butts Yes - Yes (via 5-char code)
Live leaderboard & qualification standing Yes Yes Yes (target view)
Automatic elimination bracket seeding Yes Yes (view match) -
Official scorebooks, e-certificates & financial reports Yes (export & issue) Yes (download) -

5. Frequently Asked Questions

Does Archeris manage payments and participant registrations?

Yes. Archeris provides an integrated end-to-end tournament solution. Organizers can configure ticket categories, collect payments via QRIS, Virtual Account, or bank transfer, issue automated registration invoices, and verify participant rosters before match day begins.

Can I have both an Organizer account and an Archer account?

Yes. Club managers and coaches who also compete as athletes can register an Organizer account to manage club tournaments and a separate Archer account for personal event entries using distinct email addresses.

How do scorekeepers record arrows on the field?

Scorekeepers open the mobile scoring interface on their smartphone browser, enter the 5-character target code provided by the organizer, and record arrow values as ends conclude.

Can tournament reports and certificates be exported after the event?

Yes. Organizers can export full PDF scorebooks, ranking summaries, and financial reports. Archers can also download verified digital e-certificates directly from their account dashboard.

id.title: Tipe Akun & Peran di Archeris
id.excerpt: Panduan memahami peran tipe akun pada sistem skoring panahan Archeris (digital archery scoring system) yang juga mengelola seluruh alur turnamen dari pendaftaran, pembayaran, scoring lapangan, hingga laporan akhir.

toc.text: 1. Akun Penyelenggara: Pengaturan Scoring & Kontrol Event
2. Akun Pemanah: Profil, Registrasi & Live Score
3. Petugas Scoring: Input Nilai Cepat di Garis Sasaran
4. Tabel Perbandingan Fitur Scoring & Peran Akun

id.content:
Archeris adalah digital archery scoring system berbasis cloud yang dirancang khusus untuk mendigitalkan pencatatan skor panahan secara real-time di lapangan. Selain fitur utama skoring digital (kualifikasi, eliminasi set system, dan live leaderboard), Archeris juga dilengkapi fitur manajemen turnamen lengkap—mulai dari pendaftaran peserta online, integrasi pembayaran otomatis, alokasi nomor bantalan target, hingga penerbitan e-sertifikat dan laporan hasil pertandingan.

Untuk memastikan koordinasi pencatatan skor dan operasional kompetisi berjalan lancar, Archeris menghubungkan 3 peran akun utama:

  • Penyelenggara Lomba (Organizer): Panitia, klub, atau pengurus cabang olahraga yang mengatur format scoring, memvalidasi pendaftaran, dan mengawasi jalannya kompetisi.
  • Pemanah (Archer / Atlet): Peserta yang mendaftar turnamen, menyelesaikan pembayaran, memantau perolehan live score per rambahan, dan mengunduh sertifikat resmi.
  • Petugas Scoring Lapangan (Scorekeeper): Juri garis atau relawan lapangan yang mencatat perolehan nilai anak panah langsung di depan bantalan sasaran.

1. Akun Penyelenggara: Pengaturan Scoring & Kontrol Event

Akun Penyelenggara merupakan pusat kendali bagi klub panahan atau panitia pelaksana untuk mengatur sistem scoring dan mengelola jalannya turnamen secara mandiri:

  • Pengaturan Aturan Scoring & Kategori: Mengatur jadwal, lokasi, pilihan divisi busur (Recurve, Compound, Barebow, Standar Nasional, Tradisional), kelompok usia (U-12, U-15, Umum), jarak tembak, format kualifikasi, dan kuota pendaftaran.
  • Sistem Pendaftaran & Pembayaran Terintegrasi: Menerima pembayaran pendaftaran melalui QRIS, Virtual Account, maupun transfer bank dengan verifikasi otomatis yang langsung tercatat ke invoice.
  • Manajemen Peserta & Kontingen Klub: Meninjau pendaftar masuk, memvalidasi data atlet, dan mengekspor daftar kontingen dalam satu langkah.
  • Alokasi Nomor Bantalan (Target Allocation): Menempatkan posisi nomor bantalan peserta (seperti Bantalan 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B) secara otomatis atau manual, lengkap dengan lembar cetak bantalan.
  • Monitoring Scoring Real-Time: Mengawasi jalannya sesi kualifikasi secara langsung. Setiap nilai anak panah yang dimasukkan petugas lapangan seketika terakumulasi ke sistem rekap panitia.
  • Bagan Eliminasi Otomatis (Bracket Engine): Setelah babak kualifikasi berakhir, sistem otomatis menyusun bagan tanding sistem gugur (bracket) berdasarkan peringkat skor pemanah.
  • Laporan Resmi, E-Sertifikat & Finansial: Mengunduh buku hasil pertandingan resmi (scorebook), menerbitkan e-sertifikat berverifikasi, serta memantau ringkasan pemasukan turnamen secara transparan.

2. Akun Pemanah: Profil, Registrasi & Live Score

Akun Pemanah berfungsi sebagai paspor digital bagi setiap atlet, anggota klub, orang tua atlet, maupun manajer kontingen:

  • Profil Atlet Terpusat: Menyimpan data identitas, klub asal, tanggal lahir, jenis kelamin, dan divisi busur secara aman untuk digunakan pada turnamen berikutnya.
  • Pendaftaran Turnamen Cepat: Memilih turnamen yang tersedia tanpa perlu mengisi ulang formulir pendaftaran dari awal.
  • Pembayaran Aman & Bukti Invoice: Menyelesaikan pembayaran biaya pendaftaran melalui metode pembayaran digital atau transfer bank, disertai invoice resmi.
  • Informasi Bantalan & Jadwal Pertandingan: Memeriksa nomor bantalan sasaran, jadwal sesi tembak kualifikasi, dan bagan lawan tanding eliminasi langsung dari ponsel.
  • Pantau Live Scorecard: Memantau perolehan nilai per rambahan (seri tembakan), akumulasi nilai X dan 10, serta posisi peringkat kualifikasi secara real-time.
  • Unduh E-Sertifikat Resmi: Mengakses dan mengunduh sertifikat partisipasi serta piagam juara resmi turnamen kapan saja melalui dashboard akun.

3. Petugas Scoring: Input Nilai Cepat di Garis Sasaran

Petugas Scoring (Scorekeeper) bertugas mencatat skor tembakan tepat di samping bantalan sasaran. Antarmuka scoring mobile dirancang agar ringan, cepat, dan mudah digunakan di lapangan:

  • Tanpa Registrasi Akun: Petugas lapangan tidak perlu mendaftarkan email atau mengingat kata sandi.
  • Akses Kode 5 Karakter: Panitia membagikan kode akses singkat (contoh: SK101) untuk bantalan target terkait. Cukup buka browser ponsel dan masukkan kode untuk mulai mencatat skor.
  • Input Nilai Ramah Sentuhan: Menekan tombol angka nilai panah berukuran besar (X, 10, 9, 8, ... M/Miss) setelah setiap rambahan selesai ditembakkan.
  • Pembaruan Papan Skor Langsung: Nilai yang tersimpan langsung terhitung dan seketika tayang di papan klasemen publik (live leaderboard) serta layar monitor panitia.

4. Tabel Perbandingan Fitur Scoring & Peran Akun

Seluruh peran di Archeris saling melengkapi di sepanjang alur kompetisi. Penyelenggara mengatur persiapan scoring dan menerbitkan laporan akhir. Petugas Scoring memastikan pencatatan skor di lapangan berlangsung akurat dan cepat. Sedangkan Pemanah memperoleh kemudahan pendaftaran, kejelasan pembayaran, dan transparansi skor pertandingan.

Berikut ringkasan perbandingan wewenang dan cakupan fitur untuk setiap tipe akun:

Fitur Scoring & Tahapan Turnamen Penyelenggara Pemanah Petugas Scoring
Pembuatan halaman turnamen, divisi kategori & kuota Ya - -
Pendaftaran online & pengelolaan pembayaran biaya event Ya (kelola & terima) Ya (daftar & bayar) -
Alokasi dan penempatan nomor bantalan target peserta Ya Ya (lihat jadwal) -
Pencatatan digital scoring di samping bantalan sasaran Ya - Ya (via kode akses)
Akses live leaderboard dan klasemen kualifikasi Ya Ya Ya (tampilan target)
Penyusunan bagan eliminasi otomatis (bracket tree) Ya Ya (lihat lawan) -
Ekspor rekap hasil pertandingan, e-sertifikat & laporan keuangan Ya (ekspor & terbitkan) Ya (unduh sertifikat) -

5. Tanya Jawab Seputar Scoring & Akun

Apakah Archeris mengelola proses registrasi dan pembayaran turnamen?

Ya. Archeris menyediakan sistem turnamen terpadu. Penyelenggara dapat membuka pendaftaran secara online, menerima pembayaran melalui QRIS, Virtual Account, atau transfer bank, menerbitkan invoice pendaftaran otomatis, dan memvalidasi kuota peserta sebelum hari pertandingan.

Apakah saya dapat memiliki akun Penyelenggara sekaligus Pemanah?

Ya. Pengurus klub atau pelatih yang juga aktif bertanding dapat memiliki akun Penyelenggara untuk mengelola turnamen klub dan akun Pemanah untuk mendaftar kejuaraan secara personal menggunakan alamat email yang berbeda.

Bagaimana cara petugas lapangan mencatat skor tembakan?

Petugas scoring cukup membuka antarmuka scoring di browser ponsel, memasukkan kode akses 5 karakter dari panitia, lalu memilih angka nilai per anak panah setelah setiap rambahan selesai.

Apakah rekap hasil turnamen dan sertifikat dapat diunduh setelah acara selesai?

Ya. Penyelenggara dapat mengunduh buku hasil pertandingan resmi (scorebook), statistik turnamen, dan rekap keuangan. Seluruh pemanah juga dapat mengunduh e-sertifikat resmi langsung dari dashboard profil masing-masing.
